text: Inheritance lets a derived class acquire everything in a base class, then add or redefine members. It gives reuse, and expresses an is a relationship: a teacher is a person. Single inheritance: one base, one derived. Multilevel: a chain. Multiple: one class with two bases. Hierarchical: one base, many derived. And hybrid mixes them.
